name: find-by-seller
title: Owned assets from one seller
summary: Find a seller's ID by name, then list the user's assets from that seller

steps.why: Library filters take a seller ID, not a name; this works signed out
steps.check: results[].sellerName: if several match, ask the user which one

steps.why: Fab filters the library on the server

notes: To search the whole marketplace by seller instead, use search --filter seller=<name>.
